title: Localize Agent workspace and imported-file feedback
context: The Agent workspace's link descriptions and several imported-file states remain English-only in Vietnamese mode. Dynamic import/load/delete/preview errors are stored as plain English strings instead of localized format strings.
goal: Add EN/VI catalog entries for workspace navigation and imported-file feedback, and route dynamic file-operation errors through localized format strings.
forbidden_changes: Do not change imported-file storage, deletion, or preview authorization behavior.
Do not expose secrets or change preserved original bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace link descriptions and imported-file empty/loading/error labels have EN/VI entries.
Dynamic load/delete/preview errors use localized format strings and retain error details.
No duplicate localization keys are introduced.
Settings import-library failures use localized format strings while preserving file names and error details.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Static duplicate-key scan for both localization catalogs
recovery: Revert the single task commit if workspace navigation, import handling, or localization regresses.
